reason: My tables fill from Google Maps, Instagram and people walking by, and the bookings already come to my WhatsApp. I don't see what a website adds that my Maps listing doesn't, so €600 is money for something I never needed.
objection: €600 is a lot when I don't know if it brings any bookings. Tourists find a restaurant on Google Maps, not on a website.
would_change_my_mind: If a konoba near me showed me real numbers, more reservations after their site went up, or if you did the Google Maps tidy-up first and took the €600 only once I saw more calls and messages.
